title: Behind the Curtain
description: SwiftCargo has a few feature flags that toggle per environment via env vars, not a database switch. Confirm the flags endpoint reports the correct set of known flags and reflects the API's current environment configuration.
successCondition: GET /api/admin/feature-flags returns 200 with a flags object containing exactly the keys priorityLane, extendedTracking, and newAdminUi, each a boolean.
hints: This endpoint is available to any authenticated user, not just admins — other pages read it too.
The env var naming convention (FEATURE_<UPPER_SNAKE_CASE>) is documented in docs/api/admin.md.
